[b]Feyria Asks for Recognition[/b]

Even as the dire warning from LOCUS came and set off the evacuations and implementations of the nation's defense parameters, Rosenmarkke was still open for business, though at this point it was temporarily limited. 

Thus within the secure walls of the Fort Björnsøllme National Defense Command Headquarters a message from the little known space colony on the moon of Agathar, the Confederacy of Feyria, arrived. 

The message was simple, it requested Rosenmarkkes formal recognition of its independence, and was one of the first nations to enquire following the dictat. 

A proposition of good value, chief consul, stated Ayn Rjk of the Department of International and Interstellar Relations, bowing slightly at the words chief consul.

It is, I admit, something to consider, they offer us their minerals and we our food, and according to the dictatthe deal cannot be broken except by unanimous consent from both parties, it effectively binds them to our sphere, stated Adams, taking the paper from Rjk and reading it over.

Yes, but, if we do move this to the great assembly to be voted on, what are our chances of securing a majority, general? enquired Alexander, To me it seems that the PCF, an EF loyalist faction by my opine, has the hold over legislation, the only reason why we were even able to issue the dictat is because of its economic factors, I almost had to strike out any anti-EF sentiments from it, 

There are always the Sollonists, replied Adams, turning to Angthaar who was seated next to the head of the Department of Labour and Unions.

True, replied Alexander looking at Angthaar who quietly averted his eyes, Is there something you wish to tell us Angthaar? 

Y-es, It is my belief that the sollonists do not have the votes, nor coalition power to permit the passage of this resolution for recognition, replied Angthaar.

Well d-mn it all, exclaimed Adams, Perhaps if you hadnt been twiddling your thumbs during the famine twenty years ago your lot would be able to secure us the votes we need! he smacked his hand on the table.

My [i]dear[/i] general, stated Alexander calmly, It [i]is[/i] not that our situation is dire, in fact the matter is very simple, all we have to do is slip in a few things to please the PCF, much like we did with the dictat, 

Or we rush the vote under the emergency rules, replied Angthaar.

Precisely, stated Alexander, In the meantime I will authorise Mr. Rjk to do his dirty work in his ministry, he continued, nodding at Ayn. 

In the meantime, let us inform this confederacy that we will consider their request, and that due to some minor emergency matters here, we will have to hold off on any formal diplomatic meetings, or at least move them to holo-screen meetings, he continued, leaning back in his chairnow to our next matter,

Crisis solved.
